customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install and appreciate its reliable performance with triple deadlocks for high security. They like its appearance, adding a modern touch to the door, and its features, including multiple unlocking options. The build quality is solid, and customers consider it a great value. The user experience receives mixed feedback, with some customers reporting a terrible app experience.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Professional technician
reviews.body: Great experience with the Urban Company Native lock installation. The technician was extremely professional, skilled, and handled the door fitting with neat precision. He also took the time to explain how the smart lock functions, set up the app, and cleared all the drilling mess after finishing the job. 5/5 stars!
